#### Project general facts

Glam Residence is a residential building by GJ Properties in Al Zorah, the waterfront master community on Ajman's coast. The building has a ground floor, eight residential floors, and a penthouse level. It offers studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, and a three-bedroom penthouse on the top floor. Unit sizes range from about 597 sq ft for a studio to more than 2,100 sq ft for the largest two-bedroom layouts. Many residences look out over the surrounding lagoons, mangroves, and green spaces.

On-site facilities cover both active and quieter routines. Residents have a swimming pool with a children's zone, a gym, a yoga deck and meditation area, and landscaped outdoor spaces with walking paths. The building also has a children's play area, barbecue and seating areas, and a clubhouse. Covered parking, round-the-clock security with CCTV, and a staffed lobby round out the daily conveniences.

The interiors use light tones with natural wood accents and open layouts. Floor-to-ceiling windows bring in daylight, and balconies or terraces extend the living space outdoors. The kitchens are equipped with appliances, and the bedrooms have built-in wardrobes. The apartments are delivered without loose furniture, so buyers and tenants can furnish them to their own taste. Central air conditioning is provided throughout.

#### Location description and benefits

Al Zorah lies on Ajman's northern edge, bordering Sharjah. It is a master-planned community set around protected mangroves, lagoons, and a stretch of natural coastline. The area is quieter and less dense than central Ajman, yet it connects easily to the main roads into Sharjah and Dubai. Sharjah City Centre is about 20 minutes away, and central Dubai is roughly 40 to 45 minutes away, depending on traffic.

The community's best-known feature is Al Zorah Golf Club, an 18-hole championship course close to the building. Residents can also reach the beach, the marina, and the mangrove reserve, which is popular for kayaking and birdwatching. Resort hotels, restaurants, and cafés sit within the wider development. Schools, healthcare facilities, and Ajman's shopping centres are a short drive away.

The location suits buyers who want a waterfront, nature-focused setting at Ajman price levels while staying within commuting distance of Sharjah and Dubai. Families gain from the green surroundings and nearby schools. Golfers and outdoor enthusiasts have the course, beach, and mangroves close at hand. Investors may find appeal in a ready building within one of Ajman's most established freehold communities.
